purpose: Lossless Claude source compression: actual pinned scanner, cache and durable report persistence costs.

methodology.timing: Six arm permutations balance position/order; one unrecorded warmup. Fixtures are scanner-cache cold and OS-page-cache warm. Durable writes use production fsync/rename writers.
methodology.refresh: Actual production functions composed in the worker request order: source read/verify/decode, scanner, source pack/seal/durable write, main report serialize/seal/durable write.
methodology.uncompressed: Uncompressed uses uncompressed B4102; current compresses its source sidecar with asynchronous gzip level 1. Both retain identical usage history.
methodology.exclusions: Worker startup, message serialization/structured clone, IPC queueing, telemetry, worktree discovery and UI rendering are excluded. Report and source read bytes are logical filesystem payload bytes, not physical device I/O.
methodology.attribution: Main is fixed b44a5796; uncompressed is previously published B4102; current adds lossless source compression.
methodology.correctness: Exact cold/append cross-arm sessions and daily equality and owned-key count; every append is checked against a fresh scan.
methodology.writtenBytes: Source writes are logical replacement payload bytes: production durable writers replace the inode when writing. Consecutive bigint file identities prove whether the fixture sidecar was replaced; unavailable inode IDs produce null rather than a zero-write claim. Report payload bytes are captured in the actual writer callback. Accounting stat calls occur outside measured production intervals.
